text: Post says the city canceled tomorrow's river parade after a storm warning.
evidence_text: City bulletin confirms the parade permit remains active for tomorrow afternoon.
Weather advisory was downgraded and organizers confirmed no cancellation.

text: Image caption claims wolves were filmed roaming inside a downtown subway station.
evidence_text: Transit police reported no animal intrusion at the station this week.
The circulated image matches an older wildlife-rescue drill photo.

text: Graphic states milk prices fell below $0.80 per gallon statewide this morning.
evidence_text: State agriculture dashboard lists average milk price above $3.20.
Digits on the shared poster are inconsistent with the agency template.

text: Thread claims the governor announced a midnight curfew starting tonight.
evidence_text: Governor's office posted that no curfew order was issued.
The emergency order registry has no filing for a curfew notice.

text: Post says this beach photo shows heavy snow in San Diego in August.
evidence_text: Weather records show no snowfall event in San Diego in August.
Palm vegetation and lighting are inconsistent with active snowfall.

text: Screenshot claims the central hospital shut down all emergency rooms today.
evidence_text: Hospital operations page confirms emergency intake remained open all day.
The screenshot footer uses a fake hotline number.

text: Caption says the president endorsed Candidate Nova at last night's rally.
evidence_text: Campaign transcript shows no endorsement statement by the president.
The rally photo originates from a non-election charity event.

text: Viral card says nationwide school exams were postponed by two months.
evidence_text: Education ministry calendar keeps exam dates unchanged.
The shared card uses an outdated ministry seal.

text: Claim says the mayor resigned this morning after audit leaks.
evidence_text: City council records show no resignation submission from the mayor.
Mayor's office released a same-day schedule of public meetings.

text: Post says this image captures yesterday's eclipse above Seattle.
evidence_text: Astronomy bulletins show no eclipse visible from Seattle yesterday.
Skyline in the image matches archival footage from another city.

text: Headline claims the airport suspended all flights because of runway fire.
evidence_text: Airport operations board reports normal departures with minor delays only.
Fire service log describes a small vehicle incident outside runway areas.

text: Post says this crowd image shows protests in Austin tonight.
evidence_text: Reverse search links the image to a 2021 music festival in Phoenix.
Austin permit portal lists no protest booking at the claimed venue tonight.

text: Story claims a local bridge reopened six months ahead of schedule today.
evidence_text: Transport agency timeline still marks bridge reopening for next quarter.
Construction webcam shows major deck work still unfinished.

text: Message says tax refunds were canceled for all freelancers this year.
evidence_text: Revenue service guidance confirms refunds remain available under current rules.
No legal notice indicates suspension of freelancer refunds.

text: Post claims the finance minister was detained at the border last night.
evidence_text: Border authority denied any detention involving the finance minister.
Minister's verified schedule shows a televised meeting at that time.

text: Image caption says the museum's dinosaur skeleton was destroyed in a fire.
evidence_text: Museum statement confirms no fire damage and normal exhibit operations.
Insurance incident records list no fire report for the building.

text: Claim says this video frame shows floodwater inside the national library.
evidence_text: Library management released interior photos showing dry reading halls.
Reflections around waterlines are inconsistent with room lighting.

text: Thread says election day moved from Tuesday to Friday nationwide.
evidence_text: Election commission confirmed Tuesday voting date in latest bulletin.
Shared notice uses an unofficial stamp and old hotline.

text: Post claims the wildfire map shows flames reaching the capital overnight.
evidence_text: National fire map places the nearest active front 180 km away.
Capital emergency office issued no evacuation or smoke alert overnight.

text: Image post says a military convoy entered the city center this morning.
evidence_text: Traffic cams show standard civilian flow in the city center all morning.
Defense ministry said no convoy movement occurred in the area.

text: Post claims this receipt shows bread prices tripled overnight.
evidence_text: Retail association data shows only minor weekly price fluctuation.
Receipt timestamp format does not match local POS standards.

text: Rumor says the university revoked all international admissions for fall.
evidence_text: University admissions page still lists active international intake deadlines.
Registrar memo denies any blanket revocation policy.

text: Caption states the dam collapsed at dawn, flooding three towns.
evidence_text: Water authority confirms dam integrity with no breach alarms.
Downstream municipalities reported normal river levels this morning.

text: Photo says this scoreboard is from tonight's final with a 9-0 upset.
evidence_text: League live feed shows a 2-1 result in tonight's final.

text: City notice says weekend farmers market will run at Riverside Square on Saturday.
